test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which new power has been given to the Magistrate under Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) regarding preliminary for serious cases?

options.text: Power to issue a death warrant directly.
Power to direct preliminary inquiry in cases punishable with 7 years or more.
Power to grant anticipatory bail without hearing the police.
Power to quash FIRS on their own motion.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Power to direct preliminary inquiry in cases punishable with 7 years or more**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)**, 2023, introduces new provisions to enhance the efficiency and fairness of criminal justice in India.
 
• One of the key provisions under BNSS is the power granted to the Magistrate to **direct a preliminary inquiry for cases punishable with 7 years or more of imprisonment**.
